body: The trees sway gently in the breeze, their leaves whispering secrets. Each branch seems to cradle me, providing a small but reassuring sanctuary. I close my eyes and breathe deeply, feeling a profound sense of safety envelop me. The world around me fades into a warm embrace as I realize this must be the place where nature offers solace.
